next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 must not be reference modified."; 2023: "No rule in 14.9.48.3 (SR-1 to SR-10) forbids reference modification of identifier-1; only a variable-length group is barred". The 2023 UNSTRING syntax rules, which appear complete, restrict identifier-1 only by category and variable-length group. The ban on reference modification is dropped.
